infinity.shard.power.desc: Creates a temporary mini gem: a holographic copy of one of your stones with the powers you choose. It goes straight into your inventory and binds to the first other player who receives it; whoever carries it gets a wheel page with exactly those powers, each with its own cooldown and magicule cost. You set the duration, keep up to 6 active and can delete them any time.
